name: Pile Tufting
mechanism: Insert pile yarn through an existing backing with repeated needle and loop-forming action, then secure the inserted tufts.
operating_requirement: Pay backing, pile yarn, needles, drive work and compatible anchoring finish; test tuft retention and reject damaged backing or loose pile.
consequence: Produce actual tufted domestic floor or furnishing textile; insertion alone is not a woven pile structure or a durable finished carpet.
branching_note: These are selected game production pathways, not claims that other historical implementations are impossible. All listed foundations apply; knowledge never supplies equipment or materials.
recovery: Acquire attributable pile tufting instruction or working samples, then pay for local setup and acceptance trials.

recovery_contract.local_demonstration: Insert pile yarn through an existing backing with repeated needle and loop-forming action, then secure the inserted tufts.
recovery_contract.operating_requirements: Pay backing, pile yarn, needles, drive work and compatible anchoring finish; test tuft retention and reject damaged backing or loose pile.

name: Elastic Yarn Covering
mechanism: Combine an elastomeric core with covering filament through controlled air intermingling while maintaining core extension and feed balance.
operating_requirement: Pay named elastic core and cover yarn, compressed air, guides and processing work; measure recovery and reject broken or uneven coverage.
consequence: Supply a qualified covered elastic yarn to garment knitting or cuff assembly; covering does not synthesize the elastomer or guarantee indefinite stretch recovery.

name: Leather Surface Finishing

consequence: Supply qualified finished leather for an interior furnishing or garment component; a coating neither replaces tanning nor makes every leather waterproof or structurally stronger.

name: Needle Lace Mesh

consequence: Supply a completed lace insert or trim to a garment assembly with its own repair requirements; mesh construction differs from embroidered decoration on permanent ground cloth.
